verdict: Lead cost hit a new low, but overdue work is slowing your growth.
narrative: This period your cost per lead dropped to $38.94 — a 37% improvement week-over-week — while lead volume rose 17%, both driven entirely by Meta ads delivering 40 leads on $588 in spend. Google Ads spent $969 over the 28-day window but has tracked only 12 conversions and went dark this past weekend, meaning a meaningful share of your paid budget is not yet pulling its weight. Your Google Business Profile generated 134 actions including 22 direct calls this period, though activity stalled to zero on the last two days of the window, which we're keeping a close eye on. Nine agreed milestones — including heating campaigns, LSA re-enable, and a confirmed intake owner — are overdue by four to eight weeks; those items are being escalated now and are the primary unlock for scaling your results heading into the heating season.
